description: Summary of the exhaustive exact-distance scans run during the preparation of the note (private workspace; scripts and logs are not part of this bundle). A violation would be a cover with d_h < d, d_h > h d or k_h < k; none was found. Counts are numbers of covers, i.e. of pairs (base code, choice of lifted monomials).

scan_1_all_pairs.method: All pairs (A, B) of trinomials containing the monomial 1 on every torus l <= m with given lm, k > 0; every lift of the two non-constant monomials of A and B (lift of 1 fixed); exact k_h and d_h for every cover.

scan_2_up_to_symmetry.method: Bases up to translations, automorphisms x -> x^a, y -> y^b and the swap of A and B, all orientations (l, m). Lower bound: exhaustive proof that no nontrivial logical of weight < d exists. Upper bound: transfer of a weight-d base logical when possible, exact d_h otherwise.

partial_runs_lm_28_30.status: incomplete: for the unresolved covers of distance-8 bases, logicals of weight <= 6 were excluded but weight 7 was not; not used in the manuscript

scan_3_named_codes.method: All 16 double covers per direction (x, y) of [[72,12,6]], [[90,8,10]] and [[108,8,10]] (Bravyi et al.), and all 81 triple covers per direction.

stabiliser_weight_survey.method: Exact d and s (least weight of a nonzero Z-stabiliser) for every base with k > 0 and lm <= 27, up to symmetry.
